name: Kirei no Hyouka Kijun
source:
"Next's AI rates cherry blossoms as 'beautiful' when they are over 80% in bloom."

In the near future, Androids that supposed to serve humans begins to self-destruct one after another.
The cause is the emergence of an ego within the AI, known as "Error Code 2000."
While pursuing the truth, young technical director Schnabel encounters an exceptional individual.

"I'm not malfunctioning. I've learned love."

A human-like android and an android-like human.
The two begin their strange coexistence.
